title: Shire of Christmas Island Plastic Bag Reduction Local Law 2018
citation: Shire of Christmas Island Plastic Bag Reduction Local Law 2018 (Federal Register of Legislation title F2018N00134, Authorised Version registered 20/08/2018)
evidence: Section 2 of the as-made PDF, opened 2026-11-10: "In accordance with section 74A of the Interpretation Act 1984 (WA) (CI) (Amendment) Ordinance 1992, the local law must be registered as a notifiable instrument and comes into operation once it has been registered as a notifiable instrument." The PDF prints "Authorised Version F2018N00134 registered 20/08/2018".
notes: Local law of the Shire of Christmas Island (the Territory's own body), made under s 3.12(5) of the Local Government Act 1995 (WA) as applied by the Christmas Island Act 1958. Part 1 s 5 "Retailer not to provide single use plastic shopping bag" and s 6 "Person must not represent that supplied single use plastic shopping bag is not a single use plastic shopping bag" (contents list), with prescribed offences in Schedule 1. Family F4 by the plastic-bag-ban precedent of Aruba; the wave 25 research listed it as F7. Link only: row CX-SHIRE-ADOPTED is unknown (the Shire's site carries only a copyright line). The same text is on the Federal Register (parent-state publisher, not reused).
